Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements

Note 1. Basis of presentation. The accompanying unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP for interim financial information. Certain prior period amounts have been reclassified to conform to the current period presentation. The company operates in one reportable segment.

Note 2. Revenue recognition. The company recognizes subscription revenue ratably over the contract term. Deferred revenue was $410 million as of June 30, 2025. Revenue from customers outside the United States represented approximately 38% of net revenue.

Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Overview. Net revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2025 increased 14% to $1.25 billion compared with $1.10 billion in the prior-year quarter, driven by growth in platform subscriptions. Gross margin expanded to 60.0% from 58.2%.

Operating income increased to $300 million from $250 million. Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP measure, was $410 million.

Liquidity. We generated $610 million of cash from operating activities in the first six months of 2025 and ended the quarter with $2.01 billion of cash and cash equivalents.

Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

There have been no material changes to our market risk exposures since our Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Item 4. Controls and Procedures

Our disclosure controls and procedures were effective as of June 30, 2025.

PART II — OTHER INFORMATION

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business is subject to risks including competition, cybersecurity incidents, and macroeconomic conditions that could reduce demand for our products and services.
